name: InterContinental Washington D.C. - The Wharf
positioning: Waterfront hotel overlooking The Wharf district on the Potomac River in Washington D.C., with a heated rooftop pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a waterfront base with Potomac River views
Families wanting suites and connecting rooms

facts.text: The hotel overlooks The Wharf, Washington D.C.'s waterfront district.
The hotel has views of the Potomac River.
The Spa at The Wharf offers facials and massages for hotel guests and locals.
Spa guests have access to private locker rooms, showers and the Oasis Lounge.
The fitness center has floor-to-ceiling views of the Potomac waterfront and Peloton bikes, free weights and cardio machines.
Standard rooms have a spa-inspired bathroom and a personal Nespresso maker.
At Willowsong, Chef Jeffrey Williams serves an ever-evolving menu of American cuisine built on seasonal products.
The Watering Hole is a seasonal outdoor patio bar overlooking the Washington Channel.
The Washington Monument is 1.3 miles from the hotel.
Families get spacious suites, connecting rooms and children's welcome amenities.
The hotel holds LEED Gold sustainability certification.

highlights.text: The heated outdoor rooftop pool and deck look out over the waterfront, where guests can watch the sunrise or sunset.
The suites range from Executive Suites to a two-story Presidential Suite.
The Anthem music venue is steps from the hotel.
Guests can charter a boat for a private waterside tour of the monuments.
The spa's Wharf Executive Massage blends Swedish techniques with the energy of the Potomac River.

considerations.text: The hotel has no self-parking of its own; The Wharf has underground self-parking, and the hotel offers valet parking.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy tourist area with high foot traffic.
